title: VPORT DXF revision loss refusal and retry
scope: Prevent the direct VPORT DXF writer from silently dropping nondefault fields or references that the selected revision does not encode.

preAC1015: Refuse nondefault render mode, per-viewport UCS flag, UCS origin/axes/elevation, or orthographic UCS type.
Continue refusing non-null named/base UCS handles through the existing version guard.
preAC1021: Refuse nondefault grid behavior/major interval, default-lighting controls, brightness, or contrast.
Refuse non-null background, visual-style, shade-plot, or SUN references when the target cannot encode them.
Existing version-aware ambient-color and shade-plot value guards remain in force.

verification.profiles: ASCII and Binary: AC1014 refusal then AC1015 retry/readback for R2000 UCS/render fields; AC1018 refusal then AC1021 retry/readback for R2007 grid/lighting fields and visual-style reference; AC1018 background-reference refusal followed by clearing the unsupported handle and same-codec retry.
